title: The Crystal Cave
text: A cave of crystals, pale violet, growing from every surface like frost. They ring when touched, a high sweet note, and the cave throws every sound back a hundredfold. A footstep becomes a drumbeat. A cough becomes a scream.

options.label: Walk through on tiptoe, and do not wake the crystals.

outcomes.text: You move slow and silent, yet deep in the crystals one long note rings anyway, setting everyone's teeth on edge.
You move slow and silent. The crystals hold their tongues; in the hush, everyone's head clears.

options.label: Break off a crystal. Something this beautiful will fetch a fine price.

outcomes.text: It shrieks a hundredfold. Deep in the cave something answers, and it is coming.

options.label: The steadiest voice sings to the crystals, hoping they will sing back.

outcomes.text: They sing back softly. Their song shows the way through the dark.

options.label: The Minstrel sings one note to the crystals, pure and clear, and lets the cave answer.

outcomes.text: The cave sings it back a hundredfold. The sound fills every one of you like wine.
The cave sings it back a hundredfold, and the roof comes down.
